description:
Outcome: A household applies for the coming season with up to three preferred plots, from brief.md §First version must, item 1.
Scope: Phone form, eligible upcoming season and plot choices, application schema, immutable submission timestamp plus stable sequence, durable receipt and household-level application uniqueness.
Excludes: Allocation, self-service editing and withdrawal.
Acceptance: Save 0–3 distinct valid preferred plots; reject a fourth, duplicate or unknown choice. Retry/double-submit creates one application; confirmation survives reload. Newly enrolled gardener completes the application journey.
Behaviour: Clear labelled validation, loading and no-open-season states; failed submission retains input and supports safe retry.
Verification: Form, persistence and concurrent duplicate tests, phone journey and enrollment-to-application integration.
Prerequisites: T-002, T-003, T-005.
Assumptions: Preferences optional, advisory and unranked; original application ordering immutable with sequence as tie-break.
title: Build seasonal plot applications
